race.comment: TORVEGA (5) has the strongest profile if she is forward enough first-up, with last campaign's BM62 form around Sale and Moe reading well for this. She was beaten just over a length two starts back, then worked home evenly after jumping awkwardly when fifth on heavy ground, and an easy Oakbank trial gives some confidence she is ready to run well. ZE BIRDS'N'ZEBEES (9) was beaten only a neck by PRESCIENT at this track when resuming and has a strong track-and-distance record, so he looks the immediate danger with natural improvement second-up. EQUINE HEADLINE (6) has placed in all three runs this season, including a CL1 third here last start. Racing in good order and can put it all together this time. WRITTEN GOLD (1) arrives off a Bathurst CL1 win and has the profile to be competitive. SOLAR GAZE (7) can make an impression third-up.
